title: Fast Approximate Modular Inference for Option Price Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2412.00658v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A new approximate Bayesian inferential framework is proposed that exploits multiple information sources -- daily spot returns, high-frequency spot data and option prices -- and enables fast calculation of probabilistic predictions of future option prices. This approach operates directly from the theoretical option pricing model, and does not require an explicit statistical model, or likelihood, for the observed option prices. We demonstrate that our approach achieves predictive accuracy comparable to likelihood-based modular inference, despite not explicitly modelling option-pricing errors, while delivering substantial computational gains. Predictive accuracy based on the Heston option pricing model is illustrated empirically for short-maturity options, with the rapidity of real-time updates of the predictive distributions highlighted.

translated_title: 期权价格预测的快速近似模块化推断
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新的近似贝叶斯推断框架，该框架利用多种信息来源——每日现货收益率、高频现货数据和期权价格——并能够快速计算未来期权价格的概率预测。该方法直接基于理论期权定价模型运行，无需对观测到的期权价格建立显式统计模型或似然函数。我们证明了该方法尽管没有显式建模期权定价误差，仍能达到与基于似然的模块化推断相当的预测精度，同时带来了显著的计算效率提升。基于Heston期权定价模型的预测精度在短期期权上得到了实证验证，并突出了预测分布实时更新的快速性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种直接基于理论期权定价模型的快速近似贝叶斯模块化推断框架，无需显式建模定价误差即可融合多种信息来源进行期权价格概率预测，在实现与基于似然方法相当精度的同时大幅提升了计算速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fast approximate Bayesian modular inference framework that operates directly from the theoretical option pricing model, fusing multiple information sources to produce probabilistic option price predictions with accuracy comparable to likelihood-based methods while delivering substantial computational gains.
